DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08230-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08230-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 園内で何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08230-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Can I help you with anything in the park?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08230-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08230-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人と本の話をしています。本にも池が出て来るので、目の前の池の話と混ざらないよう説明したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08230-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 本の池と今の池の話を区別したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08230-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am talking about a book with my friend. There is a pond in the book too, so I want to explain things without confusing that pond with the one in front of us.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08230-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you want to distinguish the pond in the book from the pond here. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08230-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08230-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの場面を話しているのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08230-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which scene are you talking about?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08230-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08230-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 本では冬の池を歩く人が出ます。今ここで人が池へ入っているのを見たわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08230-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本の場面と目撃した事実を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08230-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: In the book, someone walks across a pond in winter. I have not actually seen anyone going into the pond here now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08230-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish the scene in the book from what you actually witnessed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08230-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08230-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 本の場面として、先にそう伝えると分かりやすそうですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08230-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: It would probably be clearer if you first explained that it is a scene from the book.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08230-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08230-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。「読んでいる本では」と始めます。目の前の景色を説明する時は「ここでは」と分けて話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08230-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 話の導入で場面を明示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08230-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I will begin with “In the book I am reading.” When I describe the view in front of us, I will use “Here” to keep the two separate.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08230-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Make the setting clear at the beginning of your explanation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08230-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08230-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 友人の方は、同じ本を読んでいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08230-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Has your friend read the same book?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08230-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08230-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだです。結末まで話してよいか先に聞きます。場所の違いを説明した後で、知りたい範囲を聞いて続けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08230-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 相手の既読状況と話してよい範囲を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08230-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Not yet. I will first ask whether I may tell them the ending. After explaining the difference between the places, I will ask how much they want to know and continue.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08230-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check whether the other person has read the book and how much you may tell them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08230-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08230-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご相談はできましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08230-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Were you able to discuss it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08230-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08230-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 友人は最初の場面だけ聞きたいそうです。本の冬の池と、今日見える池を分けて、その場面だけ話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08230-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 相手の希望範囲に合わせて話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08230-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: My friend says they only want to hear about the opening scene. I will distinguish the winter pond in the book from the pond we can see today and talk only about that scene.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08230-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Limit your account to what the other person wants to hear. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08230-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08230-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 分かりました。お二人でお楽しみください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you with anything?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この案内は二十分と思っていましたが、列車の後に徒歩十分もあります。目的地へ着く予定をもう一度考えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 列車後の徒歩を含めた到着予定を考え直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I thought this route took twenty minutes, but there is also a ten-minute walk after the train. I want to reconsider when I expect to reach my destination.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Reconsider your arrival estimate, including the walk after the train. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 二十分は、どの区間でしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 列車の乗車です。駅へ着く時間を、建物へ着く時間として相手へ伝えてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 乗車時間と建物到着の誤連絡を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: The train ride. I told the other person my arrival time at the station as if it were my arrival time at the building.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the train journey time and the incorrect building-arrival message. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 列車を降りた後の移動も含めて、ご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check the travel time after getting off the train as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。徒歩の十分だけ足す前に、駅の出口までの時間も考えます。建物で待つ人には、駅の到着予定だったと訂正します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 出口移動も考慮して相手へ訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. Before simply adding the ten-minute walk, I will also allow for getting to the station exit. I will correct my message to the person waiting at the building and explain that it was my estimated arrival at the station.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Allow for reaching the exit and correct your message to the other person. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 降りた駅から歩く道の案内はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you have directions for the walk from the station where you get off?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 地図があります。迷う可能性もあるので、建物への到着を分単位で必ず約束するより、少し余裕を見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 徒歩地図と余裕ある到着見込みを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have a map. As I might lose my way, I would rather allow some extra time than promise an exact arrival at the building down to the minute.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Mention the walking map and an arrival estimate with some extra time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 駅名と目的地もご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also check the station name and your destination.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 確認しました。列車と徒歩を別にメモし、駅に着いてから向かうと相手へ伝えます。建物の予定時刻は移動分を含めて直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 駅と目的地と二つの移動区間を整理する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have checked them. I will note the train ride and walk separately and tell the other person I will head over after arriving at the station. I will revise the expected time at the building to include the onward travel.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Organize the station, destination, and two stages of the journey. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。お気を付けてお出かけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Take care on your way.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 資料の内容は確認できましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you been able to check the information in the materials?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。ただ、この二つを両方持ち帰ってよいか分かりません。説明で貸していただいた冊子と、配布の紙を分けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 借りた冊子と配布紙の持帰りを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. But I am not sure whether I may take both of these home. I want to distinguish the booklet lent to me during the explanation from the handout.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about taking home the borrowed booklet and the handout. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 厚い冊子は窓口でご覧いただく物です。薄い案内はお持ち帰りいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: The thick booklet is for reading at the counter. You may take the thin guide home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。冊子はお返しし、薄い方だけ持ち帰ります。手元で読んだから自分の分と思わないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 窓口資料を返し配布分だけ持つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. I will return the booklet and take only the thin one home. I will not assume something is mine just because I read it in my hands.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Return the counter's material and take only the handout. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 冊子で控えたい項目はありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Was there anything in the booklet that you wanted to note down?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 相談先の名称です。配布の紙にも同じ名称があるので、冊子を写すより薄い方の該当箇所に印を付けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 必要な名称を配布紙で確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: The name of the consultation service. The same name is on the handout, so instead of copying the booklet, I will mark the relevant part of the thin one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Find the necessary name on the handout. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 冊子には書き込んでいませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: You have not written in the booklet, have you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 書いていません。借りた冊子はそのままです。自分が持ち帰る紙だけに、相談先を確認した印を付けました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 借用資料へ書かず私物の紙だけ印を付ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: No, I have not. The borrowed booklet is unchanged. I marked only the paper I am taking home to show that I checked the consultation service.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you wrote nothing in the borrowed material and marked only your own paper. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 冊子はこちらへお戻しください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お返しします。持ち帰る紙と借りた冊子を分けられました。家族にはこの紙を見せ、次の相談先を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 資料を返して家族への共有を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Here it is. I have separated the paper to take home from the borrowed booklet. I will show my family this paper and tell them where to seek advice next.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Return the material and decide how to share it with your family. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。案内をご利用ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please make use of the guide.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 受付でお伝えになりたいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything you would like to tell reception?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 経過をメモしましたが、家族が話した体験も同じ紙に書いていました。私自身のことと分けて診察で説明したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 経過メモに家族の体験が混ざったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I made notes on how things have developed, but I also wrote my family's experiences on the same sheet. I want to distinguish them from my own experiences when I explain things during the consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that your family's experiences got mixed into your notes on your own progress. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの行がご家族のお話でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which lines describe your family's experiences?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 下の二行です。家族が以前経験したことで、私が今同じ状態だと確認したわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 他人の二行と自分の未確認を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: The bottom two lines. They describe what a family member experienced before; it has not been confirmed that I am currently in the same condition.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that two lines concern someone else and that your own condition is unconfirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご本人の状態が分かるよう、担当へ説明してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please explain this to the person in charge so they can understand your own condition.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。自分の経過は上の三行です。家族の話には別の人の体験と見出しを付け、自分の症状として読まれないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分の三行と家族の見出しを分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. My own progress is in the top three lines. I will label my family's account “Another person's experience” so it is not read as my symptoms.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Separate your three lines from a heading for your family's account. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 家族のお話で、質問したいこともありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Is there anything you would also like to ask about your family's experiences?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 似たことがあるのか聞きたいです。ただ、家族がそうだったから私も同じだと決めず、自分の状態を先に話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家族の体験からの質問と診断を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I want to ask whether there might be similarities. But I will describe my own condition first rather than conclude that mine is the same because that happened to my family member.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish questions prompted by your family's experiences from a diagnosis. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その質問も、ご本人から担当へお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also tell the person in charge about that question yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。自分の三行を先に説明し、その後で家族の話から思った質問をします。二人の経過を一つにはまとめません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自分の説明後に質問する順を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will explain my three lines first, then ask the question that arose from my family's account. I will not combine two people's progress into one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain the order: describe your own situation first, then ask your question. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。区別したメモをお持ちになってお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please wait with the notes separated in that way.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 何をなくされたのでしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人のかばんです。私が持ち主のように話し始めましたが、私の品ではないので、その点を先に訂正したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人の紛失品で自分が持ち主ではないと訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: My friend's bag. I began speaking as if I were the owner, but it is not mine, so I would like to correct that first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Correct your explanation: the lost item belongs to your friend, not you. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 友人の方から相談を頼まれましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Did your friend ask you to make this inquiry?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 駅へ問い合わせたいと話していました。私も近くに来たので聞きに来ましたが、友人本人の届けを全部代わってよいとは確認していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 友人の相談希望と代行の未確認を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: They said they wanted to contact the station. I came to ask because I was nearby too, but I have not confirmed that I may make the whole report on my friend's behalf.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain your friend's wish to inquire and the unconfirmed permission to act for them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご存じの範囲と、ご本人の確認が必要な内容を分けて伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will ask separately about what you know and what needs to be confirmed by the owner.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 外側の青い色は見たことがあります。中身は知らないので、自分がいつも持つ物を代わりに答えることはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 知る外観と知らない中身を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have seen that the outside is blue. I do not know the contents, so I will not answer with the things I usually carry instead.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish the appearance you know from the contents you do not know. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 最後に見た場所は、誰が確認した情報でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Who confirmed the information about where it was last seen?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 友人が駅のベンチと言いました。私はその場を見ていないので、友人から聞いた情報として伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 目撃していない最終場所を伝聞として示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: My friend said it was on a station bench. I did not see it there myself, so I will present this as information I heard from my friend.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Present the last location as secondhand information because you did not witness it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご本人から詳しく相談する方法もご案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We can also explain how your friend can discuss the details directly.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。私は知っている外観と伝言を分けて説明し、詳しい中身と経緯は友人から確認してもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人が詳しく相談する方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I will separately explain the appearance I know and the message I was given, and have my friend confirm the detailed contents and what happened.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask how the owner can discuss the details directly. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。相談の方法をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will explain how to make the inquiry.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日は何をお送りになりますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 小さい額縁です。ガラスは家で外し、枠と背板だけ送ります。ガラス入りのままと思われないよう、中身を説明したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: ガラスを外した額縁の中身を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: A small picture frame. I removed the glass at home and am sending only the frame and backing board. I want to explain the contents so no one assumes the glass is still in it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the contents of a picture frame with its glass removed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 写真などは中に入っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is there a photograph or anything else inside?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 入っていません。相手が自分の写真を入れるための枠です。ガラスを別の紙に包んで一緒に入れたわけでもありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同封しない写真とガラスを明示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: No. It is a frame for the recipient to put their own photo in. I have not wrapped the glass in separate paper and included it either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Make clear that neither a photograph nor the glass is enclosed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 枠が傷まないよう、梱包をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check the packing so the frame will not be damaged.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。枠の角を包み、背板も一緒に収めます。外したガラスは家に残っていると相手へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 枠と背板を包み相手へ部材を知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I will wrap the frame's corners and pack the backing board with it. I will tell the recipient that the removed glass remains at my home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Wrap the frame and backing board and tell the recipient which parts are included. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 箱の中で背板が動きますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Does the backing board move inside the box?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 少し動くので、枠から離れないようまとめ直します。ガラスがないから何も包まなくてよいとは考えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 背板の動きを直し梱包を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: It moves a little, so I will secure them together again so it does not come away from the frame. I do not assume that nothing needs wrapping just because there is no glass.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Fix the backing board's movement and check the packing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 準備ができたら、寸法と重さを確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once you are ready, we will check the dimensions and weight.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まとめ直しました。送るのは枠と背板で、写真とガラスはありません。今の中身を相手に知らせ、発送を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 実際の送付部材を整理して発送を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have secured them again. I am sending the frame and backing board, with no photo or glass. I will inform the recipient of the actual contents and discuss sending it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Clarify the actual parts being sent and discuss shipping. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。箱をこちらへお出しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please place the box here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらが手続きに使う用紙です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is the form used for the procedure.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。今日は説明を聞くだけの予定です。この用紙を受け取って持ち帰り、記入は家で考えてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 今日は用紙を受け取り記入を持ち帰りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Thank you. I only planned to hear the explanation today. May I take this form home and think about filling it out there?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that today you want to receive the form and take it home to consider filling it out. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: はい。受取りだけで、いま手続きが始まるわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Yes. Simply receiving it does not mean the procedure is starting now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。家族が用紙を見て完了したと思わないよう、説明用に受け取ったと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 受取と開始を区別して家族へ知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. I will tell my family I received it for the explanation so they do not see the form and think the process is complete.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Tell your family the difference between receiving the form and starting the procedure. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご自宅で確認したい項目はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Are there any sections you would like to check at home?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 連絡先と希望する方法です。まだ選べていないので、今日の用紙へ仮の答えを書いて提出することはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未定の項目と仮提出しない方針を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: The contact details and the method I prefer. I have not decided yet, so I will not write provisional answers on today's form and submit it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain the undecided sections and your decision not to submit provisional answers. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 記入前に分からない点があれば、お問い合わせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please contact us if anything is unclear before you fill it out.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。この案内と一緒に保管します。用紙だけ残して説明をなくさないよう、同じ袋へ入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 用紙と案内を一緒に保管する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I will keep it with this guide. I will put them in the same bag so I do not keep only the form and lose the explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Keep the form and guide together. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 戻られる時は、必要な物もご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: When you come back, please also check what you need to bring.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。今日は空欄の用紙と案内を持ち帰ります。方法が決まってから記入し、必要な物をそろえて相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 方法決定後に記入と持参物を準備する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. Today I will take home the blank form and guide. Once I decide on the method, I will fill it out, gather the necessary things, and come to discuss it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Prepare the form and required items after deciding on the method. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。ご検討のうえお越しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please consider it and come back.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お菓子選びでお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Can I help you choose some sweets?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 詰合せを選びましたが、家族が食べるのは一種類だけでした。全部少しずつ買うより、その種類だけの品に替えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 詰合せを家族が食べる一種類へ替えたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I chose an assortment, but my family only eats one kind. Instead of buying a little of everything, I want to switch to a product containing only that kind.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you want to replace the assortment with the one kind your family eats. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの種類をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which kind are you looking for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この丸い焼き菓子です。ほかの種類は家族が苦手なので、私が全部食べると決めて詰合せを買うのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 好きな種類と他種類を選ばない理由を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: These round baked sweets. My family does not like the other kinds, so I will not buy the assortment on the assumption that I will eat all the others.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the preferred kind and why you are not choosing the other kinds. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 同じ焼き菓子だけの小箱はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Here is a small box containing only those baked sweets.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: これですね。詰合せと数が違うので、箱が同じ大きさだから量も同じとは思わず、個数を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 変更品の個数を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: This one, then. It has a different count from the assortment, so I will check how many there are rather than assume the quantity is the same because the boxes are the same size.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check the number of pieces in the replacement product. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらは六個です。何人で食べますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: This contains six. How many people will share them?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 三人です。一人二個ずつ分けられます。詰合せは戻し、この小箱一つにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 人数へ割り当て一箱を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Three. We can have two each. I will put the assortment back and take one of these small boxes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Allocate the pieces among the people and choose one box. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 小箱はこちらで間違いありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Is this the correct small box?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。好きな種類が六個の小箱です。食べない種類を残す前提を変え、三人分としてこちらを買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 種類と個数と用途を確定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. It is the small box with six of the kind we like. I have changed my plan of leaving the kinds we do not eat, and will buy this for three people.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the kind, number of pieces, and purpose. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。こちらの商品でお会計へどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please take this product to the checkout.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 園内で何かお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having any trouble in the park?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 持ってきた双眼鏡を友人へ貸したいです。ひもがねじれているので、渡す前に直して持ち方を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 貸す双眼鏡のひものねじれを直すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to lend my friend the binoculars I brought. The strap is twisted, so I will straighten it and check how to hold them before handing them over.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you will straighten the twisted strap on the binoculars you are lending. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お二人とも、座って準備できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Can both of you sit down to get ready?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: このベンチで座ります。私がひもを外すのではなく、ねじれを戻してから友人に持ってもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 座ってひもを外さず準備する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: We will sit on this bench. I will untwist the strap rather than remove it, and then let my friend hold the binoculars.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Prepare while seated without removing the strap. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 通る方へ向けて振り回さないようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please do not swing them around toward people passing by.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。友人が本体を持ったことを確かめて手を離します。見ている途中で私が引っぱって向きを直すことはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本体保持を確認して受け渡す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I will check that my friend is holding the body before letting go. I will not pull on them to adjust the direction while my friend is looking through them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm that the body is held securely before handing them over. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 友人の方には、見方も説明しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Will you also explain to your friend how to look through them?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 最初は近くの木を目印にしてもらいます。遠くの鳥を急いで追うより、見える範囲を本人に確認してもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人が近い目印で見え方を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will have them first use a nearby tree as a reference. Rather than rushing to follow a distant bird, I will let them check what they can see for themselves.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Have your friend check the view using a nearby reference point. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 使い終わったら、荷物をまとめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please gather your belongings when you finish using them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。友人から両手で受け取り、ひもを本体の周りへ軽くまとめてケースへ戻します。貸す前と返す時の確認をします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 返却時に受け取り収納する手順を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will receive them from my friend with both hands, loosely gather the strap around the body, and put them back in the case. I will check them before lending and on their return.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain how you will receive and store them when they are returned. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ、譲り合って園内をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08231-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please be considerate of one another and enjoy the park.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you with anything?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 旅の記録に乗る区間の距離を書きたいです。この図では今の駅が十キロ、行く駅が三十キロとあります。二つを足して四十キロと書きかけました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 起点距離の二数を足して乗車区間と書きかけたと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to write the distance of the section I will travel in my trip journal. On this diagram, the current station is marked ten kilometers and the station I am going to thirty kilometers. I nearly added them and wrote forty kilometers.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you nearly added two distances from the starting point and recorded the sum as your travel section. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この図の数字は、路線の起点からの距離です。今回はどちらから乗られますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: The numbers on this diagram are distances from the beginning of the line. Where will you board this time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今いる駅からです。起点からここまでの十キロは、今回は乗りません。行く駅の三十キロにも、その前の区間が含まれるのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 今回の出発駅と未乗車の起点区間を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: At the station where we are now. I will not travel the ten kilometers from the line's starting point to here this time. So the thirty kilometers for the destination station also includes the earlier section.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish your departure station this time from the initial section you will not travel. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この図の差は二十キロです。運賃や実際に利用する経路は、別の案内で確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: The difference on this diagram is twenty kilometers. Please check the fare and the route you will actually use in a separate guide.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。三十から十を引いた図の差として二十キロをメモします。その数字だけで切符の料金を計算せず、利用する便と区間を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 図の三十引く十の差二十キロと運賃確認を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I will note twenty kilometers as the diagram's difference, thirty minus ten. I will not calculate the ticket price from that number alone; I will check the service and section I will use.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish the diagram's difference of twenty kilometers, thirty minus ten, from checking the fare. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: すでに乗られた区間の記録でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Are you recording a section you have already traveled?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: これから乗る予定です。まだ二十キロを移動した実績としては書きません。駅から目的の建物まで歩く分も、この図の数字には含めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 乗車予定と移動実績および駅外徒歩を区別して記録する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I plan to travel it later. I will not yet record it as twenty kilometers I have actually covered. I will not include the walk from the station to my destination building in the diagram's figures either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Record the planned journey, actual travel, and walk outside the station separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 列車の時刻は、発車案内でご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check train times on the departure information display.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。距離が二十キロだから二十分で着くとも考えず、停車駅と時刻を別に見ます。記録にはこの駅から先の予定区間と書き、移動後に実際に乗ったことを確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 距離から時間を推測せず停車駅時刻を確認して実績を後で記録する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will not assume that a distance of twenty kilometers means I will arrive in twenty minutes; I will check the stops and times separately. I will mark the journal entry as the planned section from this station onward and confirm what I actually rode after the journey.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the stops and times without inferring time from distance, then record the actual journey afterward. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。図の距離とご利用の案内を分けてご確認ください。お気を付けてどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please check the diagram's distances separately from the information for your journey. Take care.
